description.value: Jade Valley is an established Cantonese-style Chinese restaurant located inside Impact Plaza in Surrey, serving a broad menu of seafood, hot pot, and classic Chinese-Canadian dishes. The restaurant's Hot & Sour Soup earned first place at the 2007 Soup-Off competition. It operates as a full sit-down restaurant with delivery available for nearby orders.
